objective: Remove duplicate desktop page titles and one shell row by placing existing route tabs inside the application header while preserving mobile behavior and all tab operations.
users: Desktop users switching repeatedly among workbench, system, workflow and release-management pages
Phone users who need the current compact sticky header and tab row to remain operable

requirements.statement: Desktop renders route tabs inside the application header and does not render the duplicate breadcrumb or separate tab row.
acceptance: The current page title appears once in the shell
Business content moves upward by the removed row height
requirements.source: User highlighted duplicate breadcrumb and tabs and confirmed option 1
counterexample: User management remains visible in both breadcrumb and tabs

requirements.statement: Project selection, sidebar toggle, inline tabs and global header actions remain simultaneously usable on desktop.
acceptance: Tab overflow does not displace fixed-side controls
requirements.source: Existing shell workflow and selected consolidation approach
counterexample: Opening several tabs hides the account menu or project selector

requirements.statement: Existing tab navigation and context-menu behavior is unchanged.
acceptance: Switch, close, refresh, close others and close all retain their current semantics
counterexample: Moving the tabs resets tabsStore or makes dashboard closable

requirements.statement: Phone viewports retain the independent sticky tab row and current-page title.
acceptance: 375x812, 390x844 and 430x932 remain usable without page horizontal overflow
requirements.source: User-confirmed option 1 and existing mobile contract
counterexample: All phone tabs are compressed into the 56px global header

invariants: tabsStore remains the sole route-tab state source
UiTabs remains responsible for tab commands and context menu
Project context and global account actions remain visible and usable
No page-level horizontal overflow is introduced
constraints: Use existing Vue 3, Element Plus and shell components
Preserve desktop and required phone viewport behavior
Keep changes inside AppLayout, UiTabs styling and focused verification artifacts
non_goals: Redesigning sidebar, top-navigation mode or business pages

selected_approach.name: Desktop inline header tabs with mobile independent tabs
selected_approach.reason: It removes both duplicated information and a full desktop shell row while preserving multi-task navigation and mobile ergonomics.

alternatives.name: Keep two rows and weaken breadcrumb
alternatives.rejected_because: It retains unnecessary vertical space and partial duplication.

alternatives.name: Remove tabs and keep breadcrumb
alternatives.rejected_because: It removes an established repeated-work navigation capability.

components.name: AppLayout
components.responsibility: Mount UiTabs inline on desktop and below the header on mobile

components.name: UiTabs
components.responsibility: Render and operate the same route tabs in either shell placement

components.name: shell styles
components.responsibility: Constrain inline tab width, height, overflow and mobile fallback

interfaces.name: UiTabs props
interfaces.contract: currentPath remains route.fullPath regardless of visual placement

transitions: choose desktop or mobile mount point
data_flows.output: one authoritative tab strip with unchanged commands

error_handling.condition: Inline tabs exceed available desktop width
error_handling.behavior: The tab region shrinks and uses built-in tab navigation without overlapping fixed controls
error_handling.recovery: Close tabs or use the tab navigation controls

error_handling.behavior: Inline tabs are replaced by the independent sticky tab row

security: No authorization or data boundary changes
performance: No additional requests or duplicated tab state
compatibility: Preserve all tab commands and required phone viewports
operations: Build, browser geometry and console checks provide observable evidence

verification_strategy.signal: Desktop title is not duplicated, content moves upward and fixed header controls remain usable
verification_strategy.method: Browser inspection at desktop width with multiple open tabs

verification_strategy.signal: All tab commands retain existing outcomes
verification_strategy.method: Switch, close, refresh and context-menu browser interactions

verification_strategy.signal: Mobile retains separate tabs and has no horizontal page overflow
No type, build or whitespace regression
verification_strategy.method: npm run build and git diff --check

assumptions.text: Element Plus tab navigation can operate inside a flex child constrained by min-width zero
assumptions.basis: Existing UiTabs uses Element Plus card tabs and flex sizing
assumptions.falsifier: Browser evidence shows tabs expanding beyond the assigned middle region

decisions.decision: Merge tabs into the desktop header and preserve an independent mobile tab row
decisions.reason: Removes repetition and vertical waste without harming mobile ergonomics

risks.risk: Project selector, tabs and account controls compete for width
risks.impact: Header overlap at medium desktop widths
risks.mitigation: Keep side controls fixed, make tabs min-width zero and verify overflow behavior

risks.risk: Responsive conditional rendering creates two active tab instances
risks.mitigation: Render mutually exclusive desktop and mobile instances from the existing mobileView state

approval.evidence: User reviewed the landed design, confirmed it, and explicitly directed implementation.
